title: Granular Instrumental Variables in Large Panels: Identification and Inference Across Strong, Nearly Weak, and Weak GIV
abstract: arXiv:2607.02095v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: I develop asymptotic theory for Granular Instrumental Variables (GIV) in large panels with both $N$ and $T$ growing. The granular instrument is constructed from individual shocks that must be estimated from the panel. I show that this estimation has a first-order effect on the asymptotic variance of the GIV estimator. Existing methods do not account for this effect, leading to incorrect standard errors and invalid inference. I derive corrected standard errors that deliver valid inference. I also characterize how instrument strength changes as $N$ grows. This yields strong, nearly-weak, and weak regimes for GIV. In particular, I identify a previously uncharacterised nearly-weak regime in which the instrument vanishes asymptotically, but GIV remains valid. translated_title: 大型面板中的颗粒工具变量：强、近弱与弱GIV下的识别与推断
translated_abstract: 我在N和T均增长的大型面板中发展了颗粒工具变量（GIV）的渐近理论。颗粒工具变量由必须从面板中估计的个体冲击构造而成。我证明这一估计对GIV估计量的渐近方差具有一阶效应。现有方法未考虑这一效应，导致标准误错误和推断无效。我推导出修正的标准误，从而提供有效推断。我还刻画了工具强度随N增长的变化方式，由此得到GIV的强、近弱和弱三种机制。特别地，我识别出一种此前未被刻画的近弱机制，其中工具变量渐近消失，但GIV仍然有效。若T相对于N增长得足够快，估计量仍保持一致性且渐近正态，但收敛速度慢于√T。当N和T成比例增长时，（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文发展了大型面板中颗粒工具变量的渐近理论，首次证明从面板中估计个体冲击会对GIV估计量的渐近方差产生一阶效应并据此推导出修正标准误以保证有效推断，同时刻画了强、近弱与弱三种工具强度机制，并识别出一种新的近弱机制，其中即使工具变量渐近消失，GIV估计量仍保持一致且渐近正态。
en_tdlr: This paper develops asymptotic theory for Granular Instrumental Variables (GIV) in large panels, showing for the first time that estimating individual shocks from the panel has a first-order effect on the GIV estimator's asymptotic variance and deriving corrected standard errors for valid inference, while characterizing strong, nearly-weak, and weak instrument regimes—including a novel nearly-weak regime in which GIV remains consistent and asymptotically normal even as the instrument vanishes asymptotically.
